description: Public edition: An AI research system that independently develops hypotheses, conducts approved experiments, evaluates results, and produces reproducible discoveries.
body:
Autonomous Civilization Scientist. An AI research system that independently develops hypotheses, conducts approved experiments, evaluates results, and produces reproducible discoveries.

This database covers the technology as item 211 entry 31 of Manon's "100 Ultra-Advanced Future Technologies" catalog, section "Intelligence Beyond Today's AI". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: experimentally supported. Robot scientists and self-driving labs make real discoveries within narrow domains; a general autonomous scientist is unproven.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Autonomous Civilization Scientist - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: An AI research system that independently develops hypotheses, conducts approved experiments, evaluates results, and produces reproducible discoveries.
body:
Known science foundations of Autonomous Civilization Scientist.

Adam and Eve (King et al.) discovered yeast gene functions. Self-driving labs discover battery electrolytes and materials. AI Feynman rediscovers equations. LLM-based 'AI scientists' draft papers but struggle with genuine novelty and verification. No system yet operates as a general scientist across fields.

Key quantity check (Peer-reviewed AI-made discoveries to date / human discoveries per year): computed ratio 2.5e-05 against the reference value, relative error 0, within the stated tolerance of 0.5. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

title: Autonomous Civilization Scientist - Physical and Engineering Constraints
description: Public edition: An AI research system that independently develops hypotheses, conducts approved experiments, evaluates results, and produces reproducible discoveries.
body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Autonomous Civilization Scientist.

Hypothesis quality collapses outside narrow domains. Experiments need physical grounding the AI may lack. Evaluating 'discovery' requires human-level scientific judgment.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 9.2 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is fields covered autonomously vs lab automation market at 9.2 orders of magnitude (lab automation market larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.

title: Autonomous Civilization Scientist - Unresolved Problems
description: Public edition: An AI research system that independently develops hypotheses, conducts approved experiments, evaluates results, and produces reproducible discoveries.
body:
Unresolved problems for Autonomous Civilization Scientist, in priority order (research burden index 25, 2 blocking):

Generalizing beyond one domain (severity 3/3, tractability 1/3, BLOCKING; priority 12).

Judging genuine novelty (severity 3/3, tractability 2/3, BLOCKING; priority 9).

Reproducibility of AI-made discoveries (severity 2/3, tractability 2/3; priority 4).

These are open problems, stated plainly. A technology with unresolved blocking problems is not ready, whatever its promise.

body:
What would count as evidence of success for Autonomous Civilization Scientist:

Makes a peer-reviewed discovery in a blinded trial (weight 0.4; SATISFIED).

Discovery replicates independently (weight 0.35; SATISFIED).

Operates across 3+ fields (weight 0.25; not yet satisfied).

Evidence confidence: 0.75 (2 of 3 criteria satisfied). Verdict: strong. Confidence here measures satisfied evidence, not belief.
